title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
description: Add user roles and restrict access based on permissions.

slides.title: Adding Roles
slides.content:
# RBAC Basics

Extend your `User` model to include a `role` (e.g., `admin`, `user`). Then create a dependency that checks if the user has a required role.

```python
from enum import Enum

class UserRole(str, Enum):
    admin = "admin"
    user = "user"
```

slides.title: Role Check Dependency
slides.content:
```python
def require_role(required_role: UserRole):
    def role_checker(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
        if current_user.role != required_role:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient permissions")
        return current_user
    return role_checker
```

Use it in routes:
```python
@app.delete("/admin/users/{user_id}")
async def delete_user(user_id: int, admin: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.admin))):
    # Only admins can delete users
    ...
```

quizData.question: What status code should you return when an authenticated user lacks permission?
quizData.explanation: 403 Forbidden indicates the user is authenticated but does not have the necessary permissions.
